classification.difficultyReason: Identify side roles relative to the marked angle, complete the supplied trigonometric ratio and multiplication steps, then evaluate and round. Side labels, ratio hints and algebra scaffolding make each part a direct application of the taught method.

content.prompt: Find the side length by setting out your working as shown. Round your answer to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
Relative to $38^\circ$, $x$ is opposite and $13\text{ cm}$ is adjacent.
$\begin{align*}\tan38^\circ&=\frac{x}{13}\\x&=13\tan38^\circ\\x&\approx10.2\text{ cm}\quad(1\text{ d.p.})\end{align*}$
